name: DKCISSP Detection Coverage Matrix
purpose: Track implemented detection areas, evidence maturity, and prioritized gaps without implying comprehensive coverage.

coverage_policy.implemented_requires: A detector exists and has a named regression or controlled integration test.
coverage_policy.validated_requires: A controlled fixture or reproducible benchmark confirms the expected finding and evidence semantics.
coverage_policy.coverage_percent_policy: Do not calculate one overall coverage percentage from this matrix. Categories differ in scope and benchmark maturity.
coverage_policy.unmatched_findings_policy: Unmatched findings remain for human triage; they are not automatically false positives.
coverage_policy.authorization_policy: External assessments require explicit authorization and a bounded approved target scope.

categories.name: HTTP transport and security headers
known_gaps: Header presence checks do not prove that a policy is optimal for a specific application.
categories.next_action: Add header-policy edge cases and verify response handling across HTML and non-HTML content.

categories.name: CORS configuration observations
known_gaps: Wildcard origin is an observation and does not by itself prove sensitive cross-origin exposure.
categories.next_action: Add controlled tests for reflected origins, Vary: Origin, preflight responses, and credential semantics without claiming exploitability from one header.

categories.name: Potentially exposed backup/configuration/repository artifacts
known_gaps: Only URLs supplied or discovered within the approved same origin are checked; arbitrary filename enumeration is not implemented.
Filename and HTTP status alone do not confirm secrets or sensitive content.
categories.next_action: Add more deterministic path and status edge cases, then design an explicit opt-in bounded content-discovery profile separately.

categories.name: Bounded same-origin link discovery
known_gaps: No JavaScript execution, authenticated crawling, or comprehensive client-side route discovery.
categories.next_action: Benchmark pagination, URL normalization, duplicate handling, depth/page caps, and cross-origin redirect rejection.

categories.name: Technology fingerprinting
known_gaps: A technology fingerprint is inventory evidence, not a confirmed vulnerability; version inference may be incomplete.
categories.next_action: Add parser fixtures for version uncertainty, duplicate signals, and informational severity.

categories.name: Curated Nuclei HTTP template integration
known_gaps: Coverage depends on installed template version, selected templates, target behavior, and configured runtime budget.
categories.next_action: Record template-set identity/version in scan provenance and add deterministic adapter tests for timeout and partial results.

categories.name: TLS assessment via testssl.sh
known_gaps: Existing local integration coverage does not prove all TLS scenarios or external tool versions.
categories.next_action: Expand controlled HTTPS fixtures and test result normalization and missing-tool behavior.

categories.name: OWASP ZAP passive-alert integration
known_gaps: A configured endpoint or open port alone does not prove that a live ZAP integration was exercised.
categories.next_action: Add repeatable local ZAP service integration checks and document precisely which passive alerts are retrieved.

categories.name: Broader web-server misconfiguration checks
known_gaps: Risky-method signals rely on an advertised Allow header and do not prove method reachability or impact.
Stock-page signatures are low-confidence inventory signals and may be intentionally deployed.
Current checks do not yet constitute a complete server-misconfiguration benchmark.
categories.next_action: OPTIONS behavior has a scan-level fixture; add scan-level default-page coverage, then continue to controlled SQL injection and XSS benchmarks.

categories.name: SQL injection detection
known_gaps: No dedicated repeatable expected-signal benchmark is currently registered in this matrix.
categories.next_action: Create a local-only deliberately vulnerable fixture and validate the selected tool adapter and evidence quality before claiming support.

categories.name: Cross-site scripting detection
known_gaps: A prior controlled reflected-XSS exercise does not establish broad XSS coverage across contexts or frameworks.
categories.next_action: Create local controlled reflected and stored-XSS cases and measure which cases are detected, missed, or misclassified.

categories.name: API security and authorization
known_gaps: No dedicated API schema, authentication, object-level authorization, or role-boundary benchmark is registered.
categories.next_action: Add a controlled API fixture with documented roles and expected authentication/authorization outcomes.

categories.name: Authenticated application assessment
known_gaps: The bounded crawler does not log in, manage sessions, or cover authenticated routes.
categories.next_action: Design a credential-safe session workflow with explicit consent, secret redaction, and scope-aware replay tests.

categories.name: Network and infrastructure vulnerability assessment
known_gaps: The current matrix does not establish comprehensive host/service discovery or infrastructure vulnerability coverage.
categories.next_action: Define a separate authorized-scope model and local lab benchmark before integrating infrastructure scanners.

categories.name: Finding normalization, deduplication, and triage
known_gaps: Different tools may describe the same root cause differently; confidence is not a calibrated probability.
categories.next_action: Build cross-tool duplicate fixtures and track human-adjudicated false-positive outcomes.

categories.name: Approved-origin and redirect scope enforcement
known_gaps: Every new tool adapter must independently preserve target scope and be regression-tested.
categories.next_action: Require scope-validation tests in the checklist for every new scanner adapter.
